## Checklist

- [ ] Public GitHub repository; concrete `SKILL.md` or documented skill pack/integration.
- [ ] One primary category; discipline fit, hosts, and license (`Not detected` if applicable) are stated.
- [ ] Claims are factual and supported; no duplicate entry.
- [ ] I reviewed material security and operational behavior.
